Hi Pavel! Yes, for split_meeting: the working time (session length minus breaks) should be divided as evenly as possible over the blocks. If it doesn't divide exactly, earlier blocks get one extra minute. E.g., 200 mins with max_block=90 becomes 67 + 67 + 66.
